name: Orhaft Stoneback
description: A human Vedrune (rune-priest) from Kaldheim and member of the Omenseekers, wise and wary.

description_citations.text: "Orhaft Stoneback". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko takes the shard to Fynn and Orhaft on the ship and asks them to stop the fight.
timeline.quote: They're all fighting—blades out, blood on the snow—some woman goaded them on.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Orhaft warns that Niko's presence brings destruction, and Niko offers to be sent to Starnheim with a warning.
timeline.quote: If you're convinced that destruction follows me, then send me to Starnheim with a warning so they're prepared.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Orhaft agrees to give Niko what they ask for, after Niko says they never miss.
timeline.quote: Return to the ship once you've said your farewells. I will give you what you ask for.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko boards the Omenseeker ship; Orhaft names the trapped Valkyrie Avtyr and vows to release him after Niko passes through.
timeline.quote: the black-haired, black-winged Valkyrie's name was Avtyr and that those with dark wings are called reapers

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Through an Omenpath guided by Orhaft and the Valkyrie's magic, Niko leaps onto a skiff and arrives at the docks of Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The skiff bumped against a vast network of docks that disappeared into the kind of light that sings of home.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko traps a Valkyrie to stop a death-heralding fight at Jutmaw.
timeline.quote: To prevent this, Niko successfully trapped one of them and sought help from the clan leaders.

citation.text: "Niko Aris", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko journeys through an Omenpath into Starnheim, guided by Orhaft's magic and trapped Avtyr.
timeline.quote: no mortal had ventured into the realm of Starnheim before

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko captures Avtyr in a shard to prevent bloodshed and asks Orhaft for help.
timeline.quote: Niko captured Avtyr in one of his shards

citation.text: "Kjell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko announces he will seek Starnheim to warn the Valkyries of Koma, backed by Orhaft and Fynn.
timeline.quote: a decision supported by both Orhaft and Fynn.

citation.text: "Kjell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko tries to stop a brawl between the Omenseekers and Kannah instigated by Birgi while Orhaft stays aboard xer ship.
timeline.quote: While Niko was trying to stop the brawl between the Omenseekers and Kannah that was instigated by Birgi

citation.text: "Orhaft Stoneback", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orhaft and Niko discuss the captured Valkyrie Avtyr and the danger of trapping her.
timeline.quote: Orhaft and Niko engaged in a tense conversation about the captured Valkyrie Avtyr

citation.text: "Orhaft Stoneback", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orhaft agrees to help and guides a ship carrying Niko through an Omenpath into Starnheim.
timeline.quote: Orhaft guided a ship carrying Niko through an Omenpath

citation.text: "Orhaft Stoneback", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko journeyed through an Omenpath to Starnheim, where no mortal had ventured before.
timeline.quote: no mortal had ventured into the realm of Starnheim before

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
